title: Tactical Software Management System Requirements
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-APG.W6QK ACC-APG CONT CT SW SECTOR
description_text: Assistant Deputy for Acquisition & System Management, Data Engineering and Software ADASM (DES) is issuing a Request for Information (RFI) to conduct market research. The purpose of the RFI is to identify qualified sources capable of offering ideas on how to build a single, centralized cloud application to manage software for equipment used in the field (like vehicles and radios). Currently, this process is slow and messy because it relies on manual emails and separate websites. The goal is to create a "one-stop shop" to track, approve, and send out software updates so leaders know exactly which systems are ready for a mission.analyzing threats from diverse sources using advanced AI. Please see attached RFI for additional details.
